scientific_integrity: An arbitrary-parameter column-center proof accompanies independently organized direct and finite-state exact verification programs. The C_5 square C_5 count was already printed in 2016 and is credited, not presented as novel. The 2012 reference is dated to publication year only and is not assigned an artificial first-online day.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the Cartesian products C_5 square C_n with n at least 3. A counterexample applies specifically to the necessity in Bednarz–Wloch (2016), Theorem 2.5; other results are not reassessed. Publication priority requires external independent assessment.
title: Five-periodic rigidity of independent two-dominating sets on toroidal grids
